verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only outbound vendor due diligence: sending security questionnaires to vendors, creating them, and uploading questionnaire templates. Nothing documents importing inbound customer questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets) or exporting answers back in the customer's original format. Vendor-side questionnaire tooling is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this sales-side story.

support.subject: As a sales lead, questionnaires arrive in every shape — SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets — and the platform imports and exports them in the format the customer sent
